    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateMergeToAppoint" sourceRef="Gateway_Date_Merge" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppointToCatch" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Event_DateResponsesReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CatchToDateSplit" sourceRef="Event_DateResponsesReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateYesToJoin" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Date_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNoToMerge" name="No, appoint another date" sourceRef="Gateway_Date_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGamesToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissingToDownload" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Split" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesCompleteToMerge" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToRequestBeer" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join" targetRef="Task_RequestBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestBeerToCatch" sourceRef="Task_RequestBeer" targetRef="Event_BeerRequirementsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerCatchToSplit" sourceRef="Event_BeerRequirementsReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerNotEnoughToBuy" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Split" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnoughToMerge" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyToBeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnjoyToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="EndEvent_LANParty"/>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LANParty" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PlanLAN" name="Start planning">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToInvite</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToInvite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InviteToRequestGames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestGames" name="Ask friends which games they want to play">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InviteToRequestGames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestGamesToCatch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GameListReceived" name="Game list received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestGamesToCatch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CatchGamesToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Split" name="Start date search and game check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CatchGamesToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToDateMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToCheckGames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Date_Merge" name="Date merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToDateMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateNoToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateMergeToAppoint</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateMergeToAppoint</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AppointToCatch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DateResponsesReceived" name="Date responses received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AppointToCatch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CatchToDateSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Date_Split" name="8 or more people agree?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CatchToDateSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateYesToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateNoToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check whether all required games are owned">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToCheckGames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckGamesToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Games_Split" name="Games missing?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckGamesToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesMissingToDownload</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesCompleteToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesMissingToDownload</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Games_Merge" name="Games checked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesCompleteToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesMergeToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Join" name="Date and games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateYesToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesMergeToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToRequestBeer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestBeer" name="Ask friends how much beer they require">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToRequestBeer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestBeerToCatch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BeerAmountsReceived" name="Beer requirements received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestBeerToCatch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerCatchToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Beer_Split" name="Enough beer?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerCatchToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerNotEnoughToBuy</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerEnoughToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerNotEnoughToBuy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuyToBeerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Beer_Merge" name="Beer ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuyToBeerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerEnoughToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyLANParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnjoyToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LANParty" name="LAN party enjoyed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnjoyToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToInvite" sourceRef="StartEvent_PlanLAN" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteToRequestGames" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_RequestGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestGamesToCatch" sourceRef="Task_RequestGames" targetRef="Event_GameListReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CatchGamesToSplit" sourceRef="Event_GameListReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToDateMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCheckGames" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateMergeToAppoint" sourceRef="Gateway_Date_Merge" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppointToCatch" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Event_DateResponsesReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CatchToDateSplit" sourceRef="Event_DateResponsesReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateYesToJoin" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Date_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNoToMerge" name="No, appoint another date" sourceRef="Gateway_Date_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Date_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGamesToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissingToDownload" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Split" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesCompleteToMerge" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_Games_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_Games_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToRequestBeer" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Join" targetRef="Task_RequestBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestBeerToCatch" sourceRef="Task_RequestBeer" targetRef="Event_BeerAmountsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerCatchToSplit" sourceRef="Event_BeerAmountsReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerNotEnoughToBuy" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Split" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnoughToMerge" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyToBeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_Beer_Merge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnjoyToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="EndEvent_LANParty"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
